title: God Alone Is My Rock
speaker: Ryan Baird
summary: When leaders disappoint and everything feels unsteady, wait in silence for God alone. He is our rock and our refuge.
exhortation: As I read this psalm, it struck me as an excellent one for those of us who get discouraged by the political system we live in. We see people say one thing and it turns out they're lying. We look around for someone to trust, and everything seems faulty and unsteady. There are leaders I personally like, but my trust is not in them. This psalm answers the question: who do we trust? Where do we look?

It starts, "For God alone my soul waits in silence." My encouragement this morning is that waiting in silence takes more than a few seconds. It takes a while to quiet the voices in our heads and hearts. So read through this psalm, not once or twice but several times, and wait for the silence to set in. Let the presence of God give you peace in a troubled world.

One of my favorite parts is this: "Those of low estate are but a breath; those of high estate are a delusion; in the balances they go up; they are together lighter than a breath." When it comes to outcomes, they don't really mean anything. We know for a fact that our God is in control. "The king's heart is a stream of water in the hand of the Lord; he turns it wherever he will."

The righteous will have trouble in a fallen world. But the righteous have a strong tower to run to in times of trouble, and that is what Jesus is for us. So don't run to your favorite commentator. Don't run to anger or just throw up your hands. Run to the one who can comfort and protect us: Jesus.
prayer: Lord, may we wait on you until trusting you becomes not a trite phrase but a reality that creates power in us, because our hope is sure and strong. It is not weak or feeble. It is secure and rests wholly in you.

Help us meditate and soak in your word. Give everyone listening a particular scripture to meditate on all day, so that by the power of your word you create in us a radical, unshakable trust that weathers the storm of political chaos and leaders who don't live up to their promises. These things cannot be our hope. You alone are our trust and our fortress, and we put our hope in you. Help us pick up the weapons of spiritual warfare: your word, sharper than any two-edged sword, the power of your Spirit, constant prayer, and praise lifted to you. Transform our day, Lord. In Jesus' name, amen.
